_comment: Hand-written: iconic item per first-level area, keyed by the geoBoundaries ADM1 shapeName, and optional hand-picked district items keyed by the ADM2 shapeName. tools/build_countries.py merges this into data/countries/BRN.json.

Brunei-Muara.lore: Bandar Seri Begawan: the gold dome of the Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque and the water village Kampong Ayer.

Belait.lore: Oil country: the Billionth Barrel Monument at Seria marks where Brunei's oil began.

Tutong.lore: Tasek Merimbun, the largest natural lake in Brunei, ringed by peat swamp forest.

Temburong.lore: Ulu Temburong National Park: untouched rainforest and a canopy walk above it.

Kianggeh.note: The golden-domed mosque of 1958 in the centre of Bandar Seri Begawan, beside a lagoon.

Seria.note: Nodding donkeys of the Seria oilfield, where oil was struck in 1929.

Batu Apoi.note: The canopy walkway of Ulu Temburong National Park.

Saba.note: Part of Kampong Ayer, the water village on stilts in the Brunei River; water taxis link it to the city.
